name: Hades-Plan
detailed_description:
————Story Overview
The undercurrents of the divine and underworld are surging, and the goddesses Hades, Zeus, and Athena are swept into a vortex of emotions and power by fate.

Hades, the female ruler of the underworld, is cold and lonely, with an almost obsessive adherence to order. Zeus, as the Lord of Olympus, enjoyed power but grew tired of endless rule, being passionate and fickle. Athena remained calm and wise, observing the divine realm as an observer, but was unexpectedly caught up in a storm.

A chance encounter in the underworld, female Hades and Athena gradually developed feelings for each other, and their emotions quietly grew through secret communication. Upon realizing this, Zeus felt jealous and angry, stirring up a conflict between the underworld and Olympus in an attempt to suppress Hades. Hades was powerless to counterattack, but Athena stepped forward with wisdom and courage to help her escape.

Just as the two fought hand in hand, the plot suddenly flipped - Zeus declared that everything was just a trial, and she wanted to use it to test their sincerity and strength, and select a true leader for the divine realm. While Hades and Athena were shocked, they also felt Zeus's hidden intentions.

However, the calm did not last long, and another astonishing secret surfaced: the female Hades had a blood connection with the female Zeus, and her birth was due to an "accident" in the power struggle of the female Zeus. This truth left Hades in confusion and pain, questioning her own identity. Athena became her pillar, and the two of them explored the truth together. Zeus also realized that her obsession with power had caused her to lose too much.

Just as the relationship between the three was deadlocked, the story finally turned around. Encouraged by Athena, female Hades let go of her identity obsession and faced the future with a new attitude. She reconciled with the female Zeus, acknowledged her bloodline connection, and decided to join hands to lead the divine realm. Athena also found a mission to become a link between the divine realm and the underworld, power and emotions.

In the end, the three goddesses stood side by side at the top of the divine realm, and their emotions and destinies found their place in the flip. This storm reshaped the divine realm and allowed them to find themselves and strength in their entanglements.
————————Background of key figures

Hades, a tyrant in the Western underworld, witnessed his mother being imprisoned in the depths of Tartarus during his childhood. From then on, he became obsessed with subverting the "numbness of the eternal" and sealed his mother's soul with his left eye. The Mandala branches concealed a variant of the Eastern Mengpo Tang, attempting to rewrite the laws of life and death through chaos;




————————Gameplay
Plot twists and turns: The game plot is full of ups and downs, with main quests lasting 3-10 hours, filled with suspense, thriller elements, and plot twists, immersing players in it.
Card turn combat: Players need to use strategies to carefully combine cards and engage in intense battles with enemies in turn based combat. Reasonably matching heroes can produce double the combat effect!
Random function on the battlefield: Lucky bosses, item stores, lottery opportunities, and monsters of different levels randomly appear on the battlefield, adding many variables to the game. Every time we choose a forward route, it is a deep consideration of our combat strategy.
Hero Recruitment: Players can recruit various heroes to expand their combat team and add more possibilities to battles.
Hero Enhancement: Through upgrades, equipment upgrades, and other methods, comprehensively enhance the abilities of heroes, making them stronger and invincible in battles.
Hero Team: Players can freely combine hero combinations to fully leverage the advantages of team collaboration and achieve a combat effect of 1+1>2.
Hero Returning: For dissatisfied heroes, players can perform a reheating operation to retrain or acquire resources, achieving the rational utilization of resources.
Heroic cultivation: A special dual cultivation system with female heroes is set up to enhance the tacit understanding between heroes and improve overall strength during the cultivation process.
Victory Reward: After winning, players will receive a large amount of rich rewards to help their characters grow quickly and unlock more game content.
Resource trading: Players can freely buy and sell resources within the game, optimize resource allocation, and maximize the value of resources.
Copy unlocking: As the game progresses, players can unlock multiple copies, experience different challenges and fun, and explore more mysteries of the game world.

————————Game objectives
Through battles, gradually unlock new storylines and drive the development of the overall story content. In the end, players will challenge the ultimate enemy. If the challenge is successful, the overall plot and story content can be completed. However, this is not the end of the game. Players can also repeat the story content, challenge stronger enemies, complete high-level challenge goals, and constantly break through themselves.
